scientific.integrity: The original FedAvgM recurrence is specialized exactly to a scalar quadratic. Fixed-workload and period-two stability are both characterized by the complete second-order Jury criterion, and the explicit witness is exact rational arithmetic.
limitations: Identical scalar quadratic clients and deterministic full participation.
A common workload per round alternating between two positive integers.
The instability needs locally overshooting but contractive gradient steps.
No classification of arbitrary switching, stochastic gradients, or noncommuting multidimensional Hessians.

title: FedAvgM has a sharp two-period workload resonance
